## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Validation

Describe the tests or review performed.

## Safety and privacy checklist

- [ ] No PHI, PII, credentials, or confidential institutional material is included.
- [ ] Clinical or educational claims include appropriate sources.
- [ ] AI-generated content has been verified by a qualified human.
- [ ] Limitations and foreseeable misuse are documented where relevant.
- [ ] Accessibility implications were considered.
- [ ] A qualified reviewer is identified for changes involving clinical content or learner assessment.
